intro: I got into architecture because I like how buildings and public spaces look and how they feel to use. I am most interested in spaces like libraries and parks, where good design gives people comfort and makes the best use of the space.
I am detail-oriented and neat. I enjoy 3D modelling and rendering the most, and I like every stage of a project, from drafting to presentation boards.
looking_for: I am looking for an architecture internship in any kind of studio. I want to learn how real projects run in a studio, build my modelling and rendering skills on live work, understand site work and coordination, and grow my portfolio.
education: Diploma in Architecture Assistantship, KLE CIM Polytechnic
